name: proxmox-helper-scripts
summary: Archived front-end for the Proxmox VE Helper Scripts catalog; the website was merged into the Community Edition repository.
description: Former modern front-end for the Proxmox VE Helper Scripts project, built with Next.js, shadcn and Pocketbase. The repository was archived by the owner on Nov 5, 2024 and is read-only; per the README, the website has been merged into the community-scripts/ProxmoxVE Community Edition repository. The proxmoxve-scripts.com deployment returns no readable content.
